welcome_offer.description: Variable welcome offer: up to 300,000 Membership Rewards® points ("apply and find out your welcome offer, as high as 300,000") after you spend $20,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 3 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer; American Express shows the exact amount after you apply. No fixed public offer amount is published.
notes: 2026-11-13 as-high-as policy (lead decision after #95): official Amex product page (rendered GET 200, 9:20:24 PM PST): "APPLY AND FIND OUT YOUR WELCOME OFFER AS HIGH AS 300,000 Membership Rewards® Points after you spend $20,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 3 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer." Offer terms page (GET 200, 9:21:17 PM PST): "As High As 300,000 Membership Rewards® points Welcome Offer ... which will be an amount as high as 300,000 points. This means that the amount of points which you are eligible to earn with your Welcome Offer may be less than 300,000 points." No 'Offer ends' date or limited-time/increased-offer language on the page. The 'as high as' amount is targeted/variable, so it is not stored as a fixed bonus: bonus_points 300000 -> 0 with bonus_value 'Varies', estimated_value 5100 removed, is_elevated true -> false (current page copy has no elevated-offer language). Spend/months unchanged (stated as fixed terms on the page).

2026-11-13 bonus_points_max 300,000 added (lead decision; display shows 'up to X / varies'). Re-confirmed on the official Amex page (rendered GET 200, 9:39:18 PM PST): "AS HIGH AS 300,000 Membership Rewards® Points after you spend $20,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 3 months of Card Membership". bonus_points stays 0 / Varies; sorting unaffected.
